note: The config each grafted trait was emitted from, kept so a re-emit is a command rather than an archaeology exercise. Nothing reads this file: the emitted components are the host's source from the moment they land, and no check diffs them against a fresh emit. What it buys is that the diff CAN be taken — by hand, by someone who has changed the scaffold and wants to see what moved. Written by hand today; `graft-trait` persisting it is the mechanised half and is not built yet.
